title: Failed bolus by SMS was actually delivered
symptom: An SMS bolus command was reported as failed, but the bolus was actually delivered, resulting in a double bolus. The user also reports more frequent 'bolus delivery failed' notifications when using AAPS directly, even though the bolus was delivered.
cause: The issue is suspected to be related to Combo v2 driver behavior during bolus delivery, which may have caused confusion inside the Combo pump.
fix: dv1 added changes to alter how the driver behaves during bolus delivery, but it is not guaranteed to fix the problem. Users are asked to test the new version.
evidence_quote: I added changes that, among other things, alter how the driver behaves during bolus delivery. The previous behavior may have caused confusion inside the Combo. However, it is not (yet) guaranteed to fix the problem.
